scheduleNotes.message: DRAFT schedule — session topics, readings and presentation assignments are placeholders and will change.
Onboarding phase (weeks 1–3): lectures every session, plus the ticket burn-down. Come to Thu 9/10 with a local dev environment running.
Project bids due Thu 9/17. Teams announced Thu 9/24.
Studio phase begins. Weekly rhythm: Mon standup + clinic · Wed tech talk or student presentations · Thu team work session, game day or demo day.
All three sessions this week run async: Mon 10/5 Discord standup, Wed 10/7 recorded talk, Thu 10/8 Drill Zero. Leave Thu 10/1 with a sprint plan through Oct 13.
Async week — instructor at OOPSLA/ISSTA. Mon 10/5 written standup, Wed 10/7 recorded talk + discussion thread, Thu 10/8 Drill Zero (async, pass/fail).
Feature freeze Mon 11/23. Weeks 13–14 are hardening, documentation and ops playbooks for the January 2027 handoff.

metadata.description: A professional practicum capstone. Fifty students work as one team on Pawtograder, a production platform with 1,500+ weekly active users, practicing the full software development lifecycle from design through operations.
